## Summary

## Related issues

## Testing

List the commands and manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant to the project.
- [ ] `bun run check` passes.
- [ ] Behavior or UI changes were tested in Chrome and Firefox, or testing gaps are explained.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation were updated where needed.
